senses.definition: A Meitei ethnic male given name.
A Meitei emperor of the Ningthouja dynasty, who ruled Kangleipak, in the 12th century CE.
The eighth month of the civil year and the second month of the ecclesiastical year in the Jewish calendar, after Nisan and before Sivan.
A dialect of English used by the Rastafari.
A genre of slice of life fiction, portraying characters living out peaceful lives in calming environments, intended to have a healing effect on the audience.
A form of hatha (yoga) that focuses on precision in asana and pranayama
A queen mother of the Kingdom of Benin.
A citrus fruit from Japan, with a more bitter taste than an orange, Citrus × iyo.
